name: Intelsat (public ephemeris) Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls Intelsat's public operator ephemeris over HTTP on a timer, re-emits each satellite as a schema-exact SDS OEM record, and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic Intelsat public-ephemeris pull (default every 24h; Intelsat refreshes the ECF/center-of-box ephemeris files weekly — a daily poll catches every refresh with margin).

methods.description: Fetches Intelsat's public operator ephemeris over HTTP, re-emits each satellite as a schema-exact SDS OEM record, signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer published for each pulled + stored Intelsat ephemeris.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull.
